column1: # gentoo-install — VIDEO_CARDS detection table
# VIDEO_CARDS decides which DRI/DDX drivers mesa, xorg-server and the kernel
# firmware packages build. Getting it wrong costs a rebuild of mesa and of
# every package that links against it, which is why it is worth detecting
# rather than leaving to the profile default.
# The match column is a fixed string, compared case-insensitively against the
# VGA and Display controller lines of `lspci`. First match wins, so the rows
# are ordered from the most specific to the most general: a virtual machine
# reports a vendor that would otherwise match a real card.
# Nothing here selects a proprietary driver. x11-drivers/nvidia-drivers is a
# licence decision and a kernel-module decision, and an installer that makes
# either of them silently is an installer that surprises people (DESIGN.md
# §15). The nouveau row installs the free driver; switch it by hand:
#     video_cards = nvidia
# When nothing matches, VIDEO_CARDS is left out of make.conf entirely rather
# than guessed: the profile's own default is a better answer than a wrong one.
# columns: match
